metadata.title: Fresh Fish Roasting at Chitrakot Waterfalls | चित्रकोट जलप्रपात पर दारू में मछली कैसे भूनी गई
metadata.description: Chitrakot waterfalls in Bastar of Chhattisgarh is famous for it's scenic beauty in the world. But a very few people know that Chitrakot is a tribal village on the banks of Indravati river and the waterfall is named after this village. Our team met tribals of this area and they cooked fish for us at the waterfall.
